sources.title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models: How Vertex AI Takes LLMs to the Next ...
sources.snippet: 3. Fine-tune a large language model This codelab uses Vertex AI SDK for Python to fine-tune the model. You can perform fine-tuning using the other options as well — HTTP, CURL command, Java SDK, Console. You can fine-tune and evaluate your model for customized responses in 5 steps. You can refer to the full code in the file llm_fine_tuning_supervised.ipynb from the repository.
